title: State Reducers
description: Learn the state reducer pattern for customizable component behavior.
longDescription: The state reducer pattern lets consumers intercept and customize state changes in reusable components. Inspired by Redux reducers, this pattern gives users full control over how state updates happen without modifying the component's source code.
whatYouLearn: Understand the state reducer pattern and how it enables customizable behavior
Use useReducer for complex state transitions in React components
Build reusable components that accept custom reducer functions
Compose multiple reducers together for sophisticated state logic
Apply the state reducer pattern to build flexible component libraries
